generation_prompt.prompt: Create a premium {{size}} price card social media post for {{brand_name}}. Style: formal luxury product or price layout with generous whitespace, elegant serif typography, and a structured centered grid. Background: {{color_palette.background}}. Accent: {{color_palette.primary}}. The design must feel high-end with clear, prominent price or offer presentation. Brand logo at top, CTA ribbon or button at the bottom.
generation_prompt.important_instruction: Layout: BRAND LOGO top-center, formal headline in large serif typography centered, decorative divider lines in {{color_palette.primary}}, price or offer information prominently displayed in center, supporting copy below in smaller text, CTA button or ribbon at bottom in {{color_palette.primary}}. Generous whitespace throughout — no clutter.
